verdict.rationale: The evidence documents REST endpoints such as POST /acp/v1/instructions and POST /acp/v1/tokens in HTML docs, plus an llms.txt index, an MCP server and a prose TAP specification. None of these is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt file and the MCP toolkit are adjacent agent-facing features, not a machine-readable API definition, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
